pilot_policy: common N; powers of two; three new-process pilots per condition all >=1000ms
outside: source loading/static compilation, adapter, required Setup, post validation/TearDown/output
inside: N original Run calls plus loop/call control, original in-Run assertions, GC, helper, builtin and dynamic work
capture_Run: local function reference; runRichards and microRun do not read their entry this; never cache workload internal methods
failures: preserve; no retry or outlier deletion; version-specific correctness failure stops comparison
statistics: median; mean; sample sd; Tukey-halves Q1/Q3/IQR; min/max; paired complete-triple bootstrap 10000; seed 20261025; percentile linear 95% exploratory intervals
forbidden_attribution: single hash cost from total time
QuickJS expected IC gain equals V8 switch effect
formal_gate: protocol_amendment.md: configuration switch; no direct OFF snapshot requirement
note: Inherited rules, amended gate before any pilot; no historical time reused
